details.values: Sales units fluctuate monthly with several sharp drops (outliers) visible throughout the timeline; general upward trend from about 130 units x 10,000 in 2000 to over 200 units x 10,000 by 2022.

elements.summary: This line chart shows the company's monthly sales trend over more than two decades, including all outliers, illustrating fluctuations and an overall increasing sales trend.
